canvas.$description: Canvas — the constant base of every scene across all five phases, a near-black cinematic void rather than corporate pure black

canvas-elevated.$description: Canvas Elevated — the one exceptional raised surface, used only for the Gift Reveal translucent panel or an Earth Scene Overlay legibility scrim

text-primary.$description: Text Primary — warm off-white for question copy, destination names, and reveal headlines

text-secondary.$description: Text Secondary — muted cool gray for supporting body copy and gift reveal sub-text

text-tertiary.$description: Text Tertiary — quietest readable gray for the progress indicator, scroll hint, and captions

accent-primary.$description: Accent Primary — restrained violet, the signature accent of the question phase

accent-atmosphere.$description: Accent Atmosphere — cool blue/cyan governing space, the Earth, and the country sequence

accent-reveal.$description: Accent Reveal — soft champagne/gold reserved for the final destination reveal and gift reveal

accent-rose.$description: Accent Rose — optional muted warm tone used extremely sparingly beneath the gift reveal, never a dominant color

border-subtle.$description: Border Subtle — hairline dividers and chip edges at rest, barely visible

primary.$description: Glow Primary — halo behind a selected Answer Chip during the question phase

atmosphere.$description: Glow Atmosphere — halo around Country Markers, Route Highlights, and the Earth's lit edge

reveal.$description: Glow Reveal — halo behind the Final Destination Reveal and Gift Reveal headline

canvas.$description: Surface level 0: the constant base of every scene

elevated.$description: Surface level 1: the one exceptional translucent panel, used sparingly

answer-selected.$description: Surface (interactive): wash behind a selected Answer Chip only

ppneuemontreal.$description: Single typeface across the entire experience. Display sizes (78-113px) carry the intro title and the two major reveals at weight 400 with tight negative tracking. Weight 200 is reserved for the few lines of body copy. Weight 600 at 14px with 0.35px tracking, uppercase, serves only the progress indicator and country-marker labels. Hierarchy is built from scale, never from boldness.

body.$description: Gift Reveal supporting line, any narrative aside

waypoint.$description: Compact Destination Label, Country Marker caption

transition.$description: Transition Message (default), Earth Scene Overlay copy

reveal.$description: Final Destination Reveal, Intro subtitle, large Transition Message

display.$description: Intro Title Block, Gift Reveal headline

full.$description: Country Marker dot, scroll hint dot, any tiny circular point

answer.$description: Answer Chip / Answer Button — soft rounded rectangle, short of a full pill

surface.$description: The one exceptional translucent panel (Gift Reveal, Earth Scene Overlay scrim)

content-max-width.$description: Bounds question, transition, and gift-reveal text blocks for readability

scene-padding.$description: Safe inset between scene content and the viewport edge

element-gap.$description: Default spacing between a headline and what follows it

cinematic.$description: Fades into space, Earth camera beats, final reveal
Signature slow-out easing for most motion in the system

standard.$description: Fallback easing for quick, functional state changes
